title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash 056d31f9c195… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash 056d31f9c19593f25a51965e279098aa487c79e5d2600eb56176cb34d8146746 was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-11-16. The file was detected seven times in attacker activity involving the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer) originating from attacker infrastructure in the Netherlands. This hash corresponds to a specific malicious payload such as a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. Organizations are advised to match this hash against files in their environments and security feeds to detect potential compromise.
